title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Junior
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend – Golang
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com sólida experiência em Golang, para atuar em soluções de alta escalabilidade, resiliência e performance. O(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de microsserviços, práticas de DevOps, integração contínua e observabilidade, em um ambiente moderno baseado em Kubernetes e arquiteturas cloud-native.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e microsserviços em Golang, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura (MVC, Hexagonal, Clean Code) e realizando code reviews.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, testes unitários e de integração, além de atuar com CI/CD e práticas DevOps.
  • Realizar deploys e troubleshooting em Kubernetes (pods, serviços, rollouts), utilizando K9s, Splunk e Datadog para observabilidade.
  • Trabalhar com clusters gerenciados (EKS/AKS) e manifests YAML para configuração e versionamento.
  • Criar e manter Helm Charts para automação de deploys e gestão de configurações por ambiente.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência sólida com Golang no desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo deploy, troubleshooting e rollouts.
  • Experiência com Helm (criação, customização e manutenção de charts).
  • Vivência com EKS/AKS, YAML e pipelines de integração contínua.
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB).


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência com ArgoCD / Argo Workflows para automação de pipelines e releases.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Crossplane ou CloudFormation).
  • Práticas de DevOps e Gitflow, com uso de GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, SQS/SNS, Service Bus).
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e cultura de observabilidade.


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota - Brasil
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)

title: EMS Specialist
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a EMS Specialist , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, remote, in Brazil.


In this role you will:

Responsible for the implementation, operation, and optimization of Energy Management Systems (EMS) supporting power generation and transmission networks. This role focuses on ensuring reliable, efficient, and secure operation of the electrical system. Experience in EMS platforms (GE products) required.


Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and maintain EMS platforms for real-time monitoring and control of generation units and transmission assets.
  • Support generation control, frequency and voltage regulation through EMS functionalities.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on EMS software to generation and transmission environments.
  • Act as a middle between the client and the EMS development team and check if EMS customizations/applications are following the technical specification.
  • Provide technical support and training to operational and engineering teams.
  • Validate EMS data model.
  • Collaborate with SCADA system teams for proper integration.
  • Adjustment of network and generation applications (in run time).
  • Create a valid DTS (Dispatcher Training Simulator) model and test DTS events with the customer.
  • Analyze operational data to identify opportunities for optimizing generation dispatch, transmission flows, and system efficiency.
  • Provide support to project teams by assisting with troubleshooting, application data modeling, and implementing effective solutions.
  • Maintain and organize project documentation, including technical reports and drawings.
  • Provide training to users and operators as needed.


Qualifications / Essential Criteria:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or related field.
  • Fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing).
  • Proven experience in EMS platforms (GE products).
  • Strong understanding of transmission/generation system operations.


Desirable Criteria:

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts effectively.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Committed to maintaining the highest standards of service quality in all aspects of project delivery.
  • Good troubleshooting skills: know how to identify and escalate problems that have an impact on the client and / or strategic initiatives.

title: Senior FullStack Developer (Python/React) relocation to Portugal
description:
Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


Our client is a fast-growing startup that is on a mission to change the deskless work experience. They created a management platform that allows to easily manage all operations, from scheduling to payroll. With over 3.8B deskless workers across the globe, the challenges and potential are endless. Product includes various features: scheduling and time tracking, task management, communication management, chat, knowledge base, help desk, HR & people management, recognition & rewards, documentation, training etc.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Fullstack Developer , to further develop the management platform. You will build a product that customers love and use on a daily basis, a product that is fun to use, fast, reliable and scalable. You will tackle a wide array of problems from developing a UI that is responsive to the user and fun to choosing the right backend technologies to solve specific product use cases at scale.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience developing scalable applications using both frontend and backend technologies.
  • 5+ years of experience with Python .
  • 3+ years of experience with React , including State Management libraries like MobX, redux .
  • Extensive hands-on experience with MongoDB and MySQL at an expert level.
  • Deep expertise in message queues, especially RabbitMQ , for building scalable, message-driven systems.
  • Experience with both AWS and Azure
  • Ability to understand the pros and cons of different architecture decisions and choose the best option.
  • Experience scaling services to millions of users.
  • Understands the complexity of web technology, constraints, UI/UX.
  • Startup mindset and a proactive, ownership-driven approach, experience in product companies will be a great advantage.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex Python applications.
  • Collaborate with product management and other stakeholders to define technical requirements and deliverables.
  • Write clean, efficient, and self-documented code.
  • Implement automation tests.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.
  • Monitor application performance and provide optimization recommendations.
  • Stay up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends.
  • Drive the continuous technological improvement process.



What we offer:

  • 22 days of annual leave per year + 3 paid sick leaves
  • Flexible working hours & remote work model
  • Permanent contract or B2B contract
  • Health Insurance (employee)
  • Modern, well-equipped office in the centre of Porto
  • Intellias Communities (Tech, Language Clubs, Sports, Books, Parents)
  • Coverflex benefits
  • Snacks and drinks at the office
  • Access to discount platform
  • Relocation package


At Intellias, where technology takes center stage, people always come before processes. We're dedicated to cultivating a tech-savvy environment that empowers individuals to unlock their true potential and achieve extraordinary results. Our customized benefits not only prioritize your well-being but also charge your professional growth, making this opportunity an ideal match for tech enthusiasts like you.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Junior
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend – Golang
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com sólida experiência em Golang, para atuar em soluções de alta escalabilidade, resiliência e performance. O(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de microsserviços, práticas de DevOps, integração contínua e observabilidade, em um ambiente moderno baseado em Kubernetes e arquiteturas cloud-native.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e microsserviços em Golang, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura (MVC, Hexagonal, Clean Code) e realizando code reviews.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, testes unitários e de integração, além de atuar com CI/CD e práticas DevOps.
  • Realizar deploys e troubleshooting em Kubernetes (pods, serviços, rollouts), utilizando K9s, Splunk e Datadog para observabilidade.
  • Trabalhar com clusters gerenciados (EKS/AKS) e manifests YAML para configuração e versionamento.
  • Criar e manter Helm Charts para automação de deploys e gestão de configurações por ambiente.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência sólida com Golang no desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo deploy, troubleshooting e rollouts.
  • Experiência com Helm (criação, customização e manutenção de charts).
  • Vivência com EKS/AKS, YAML e pipelines de integração contínua.
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB).


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência com ArgoCD / Argo Workflows para automação de pipelines e releases.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Crossplane ou CloudFormation).
  • Práticas de DevOps e Gitflow, com uso de GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, SQS/SNS, Service Bus).
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e cultura de observabilidade.


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota - Brasil
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer "#983334"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio da entrega de serviços exclusivos que combinam escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão de obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , o que nos permite estar próximos de nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e temos orgulho de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos o compromisso de atrair e reter os melhores talentos, construindo conexões reais para a vida. Atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas.

Acreditamos que, ao unir talento, tecnologia e organizações certas, é possível desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucesso — tanto para os clientes que atendemos quanto para os consultores que contratamos.

Cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia.

Compartilha desses valores? Então aqui é o seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo e aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e manter o portfólio de serviços e aplicações do time de Developer Tools.
  • Atuar diretamente com times técnicos e de negócio para garantir o bom funcionamento de soluções voltadas a Data Warehousing e Analytics , com foco em GitHub e ferramentas de automação.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes globais, incluindo Software Security Group , Infrastructure Operations , Cloud Services , Managed Service Providers e Developer Community .
  • Administrar e otimizar ambientes de GitHub e JFrog , aplicando boas práticas de CI/CD (GitHub Actions) e automação de deploys.
  • Executar atividades de security scanning , gerenciamento de módulos reutilizáveis (Reusable Modules, YAML ) e integração com ambientes em nuvem (Azure) .
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts automatizados (Bash, PowerShell ), além de APIs (REST APIs ).
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e segurança para melhorar continuamente os processos de suporte e interação técnica.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e antecipar mudanças no cenário tecnológico, garantindo melhoria contínua na operação e suporte aos usuários.


O que você precisa ter

  • 3+ anos de experiência em funções técnicas relacionadas a DevOps, Developer Tools, Cloud ou Data Engineering .
  • Experiência com GitHub , CI/CD (GitHub Actions) e JFrog .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de software e security scanning .
  • Experiência com Azure ou outras plataformas de nuvem.
  • Familiaridade com gerenciamento de código-fonte (Git) , testes automatizados e metodologias ágeis .
  • Conhecimento prático em YAML e módulos reutilizáveis .
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas técnicos complexos , com boa comunicação e foco em atendimento ao cliente.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente , para interação com equipes globais.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com DevSecOps e práticas ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software , especialmente em JavaScript, TypeScript ou Python .
  • Experiência com automação de scripts (Bash, PowerShell) .
  • Conhecimento em APIs (REST APIs) e integração de sistemas.
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes colaborativos e internacionais .
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com boa capacidade de priorização e entrega sob pressão.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office.


Modelo

CLT

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

title: Gerente de projetos sênior
description:
Somos a única solução completa para o mercado financeiro!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação no mercado, e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe e mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros.


Requisitos

Contexto da Função

Atuação em projetos back-office, com foco na Diretoria de Finanças, sendo a área Fiscal/Tributária e Contábil os principais demandantes.

Ambiente com baixa maturidade em gestão de projetos, exigindo acompanhamento próximo, escalonamento quando necessário e suporte à gestão direta para garantir entregas.


Responsabilidades Principais

Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos relacionados a processos financeiros, fiscais e contábeis.

Garantir documentação completa e organizada (cronogramas, atas, planos de risco).

Realizar gestão de riscos, mapeando e mitigando impedimentos.

Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para resolver bloqueios e garantir cumprimento de prazos.

Apoiar a gestão direta na visibilidade das atividades e status dos projetos.


Ferramentas e Tecnologias

SAP (módulos FI/CO e MM – estoque).

Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: MS Project, Jira, Trello).

Excel avançado para relatórios e controles.


Perfil Desejado

Senso de urgência e comprometimento com resultados.

Proatividade: “corre atrás” para remover impedimentos e garantir entregas.

Excelente comunicação e habilidade para lidar com áreas diversas.

Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e em ambientes com baixa maturidade.

Forte orientação para processos e documentação.


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia em projetos fiscais/tributários e contábeis.

Conhecimento em governança de projetos e metodologias (PMBOK, Agile híbrido).

Vivência em ambientes corporativos com sistemas ERP (SAP).


Presencial 3x na semana na Berrini, São Paulo - SP.

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação no mercado, e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe e mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros.


Requisitos

Contexto da Função

Atuação em projetos back-office, com foco na Diretoria de Finanças, sendo a área Fiscal/Tributária e Contábil os principais demandantes.

Ambiente com baixa maturidade em gestão de projetos, exigindo acompanhamento próximo, escalonamento quando necessário e suporte à gestão direta para garantir entregas.


Responsabilidades Principais

Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos relacionados a processos financeiros, fiscais e contábeis.

Garantir documentação completa e organizada (cronogramas, atas, planos de risco).

Realizar gestão de riscos, mapeando e mitigando impedimentos.

Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para resolver bloqueios e garantir cumprimento de prazos.

Apoiar a gestão direta na visibilidade das atividades e status dos projetos.


Ferramentas e Tecnologias

SAP (módulos FI/CO e MM – estoque).

Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: MS Project, Jira, Trello).

Excel avançado para relatórios e controles.


Perfil Desejado

Senso de urgência e comprometimento com resultados.

Proatividade: “corre atrás” para remover impedimentos e garantir entregas.

Excelente comunicação e habilidade para lidar com áreas diversas.

Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e em ambientes com baixa maturidade.

Forte orientação para processos e documentação.


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia em projetos fiscais/tributários e contábeis.

Conhecimento em governança de projetos e metodologias (PMBOK, Agile híbrido).

Vivência em ambientes corporativos com sistemas ERP (SAP).


Presencial 3x na semana na Berrini, São Paulo - SP.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Azure Data Engineer, Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Azure Data Bricks; Azure Data Factory; Azure Data Services

Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Use of Data Quality tools (Great Expectations, Soda).

Knowledge of Step Functions, EventBridge, or Kinesis.

Best practices for API security (Cognito, WAF, IAM Policies).

Soft Skills:

Good communication and teamwork.

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Ability to handle agile environments and rapid changes.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, etc.)

Build high-performance data processing solutions with Apache Spark (PySpark) on Azure Databricks.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver clean, reliable datasets.

Optimize data workflows/pipelines for performance and cost efficiency in a cloud environment.

Implement best practices around data security, governance, and compliance.

Develop CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance existing data solutions for reliability and performance.

Document design patterns, best practices, and operational procedures.

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Front-end AEM Sênior que queira atuar em projetos desafiadores, contribuindo para soluções digitais de alto impacto. Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com performance e qualidade de código, essa vaga é para você!


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes e templates no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Trabalhar com HTML, CSS (SASS, LESS) e JavaScript (ES6+) para criar interfaces modernas e responsivas.
  • Garantir boas práticas de SEO técnico, incluindo otimização de metadados, SSR, Core Web Vitals e acessibilidade (WCAG).
  • Implementar e gerenciar consentimento de cookies (LGPD, GDPR) com ferramentas como OneTrust ou Cookiebot.
  • Integrar frameworks modernos (React, Next, Angular ou Vue.js) ao AEM.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações (lazy loading, minificação de assets, caching, uso de CDNs).
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (design, PMs e backend) para entrega de soluções de ponta.
  • Apoiar práticas de CI/CD, Docker, Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Assegurar boas práticas de segurança web (XSS, CSRF, Content Security Policy).


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Front-end.
  • Experiência sólida com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): componentes, templates, clientlibs, Sling Models, OSGi services.
  • Domínio de HTML, CSS (SASS, LESS) e JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript e Webpack.
  • Experiência com GraphQL e REST APIs.
  • Prática em SEO técnico e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de cookies e consentimento (LGPD, GDPR).
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD, Docker, Git e metodologias ágeis.
  • Noções sólidas de segurança web.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;

title: Fullstack - Vue / Nuxt - Developer
description:
POSITION: Fullstack Developer - Vue / Nuxt
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

AtlasIntel seeks talented Fullstack Engineers with a focus on frontend development . If you excel at building sleek, user-friendly interfaces and solving complex problems , you’ll thrive on our team. We value candidates with a strong algorithmic foundation , analytical prowess , and a proactive mindset .

Our ideal engineers are self-starters who can handle dynamic, fast-paced environments , manage multiple projects , and embrace learning new technologies. You’ll collaborate with designers , engineers , and stakeholders to drive the next generation of our platforms and tools.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will

  • Develop robust APIs for various applications.
  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions .
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews , testing , and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.


WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js .
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6) , HTML5 , CSS , and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt .
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills , attention to detail , and an ability to learn quickly.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python , Java , or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture


ABOUT US

AtlasIntel is a fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Our cutting-edge polling and market research tools have established us as the most accurate pollster for both the 2024 and 2020 US presidential elections. Founded by two Harvard PhDs, we specialize in real-time data collection and analytics that fuel dashboards with insights spanning economics, politics, culture, and society. Join us and help shape the future of data-driven intelligence.


WHY ATLASINTEL?
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that’s revolutionizing the polling industry.
  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
  • Work in a dynamic environment where innovation and learning are encouraged.
  • Contribute to products that have real-world impact on business, politics, and society.

﻿

APPLY TODAY!

Join us on our journey to shape the future of polling and market research. Reach out to us at or visit our website at for more information.

title: Sales Account Executive (Fluent English)
description:
Sales Account Executive – U.S. Market (Remote)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, consistency, and growth. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we provide a structured and high-performance environment for sales professionals who aim to grow internationally. This position is for sales professionals ready to lead B2B prospecting in the U.S. market , with real opportunities for development, recognition, and long-term stability.


What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 reais + USD-based bonuses ;
  • 100% remote work, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);
  • Exposure to U.S. executive-level sales culture;
  • Intensive onboarding (3–5 weeks) and internal certifications.


What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify B2B leads through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach;
  • Track key sales metrics and pipeline performance;
  • Conduct meetings and present solutions to U.S.-based executives;
  • Collaborate with Business Development and CRM teams for process improvement;
  • Maintain a disciplined, results-driven sales rhythm.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in Business Sales / Outbound reach ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – clear, natural communication in meetings;
  • Familiar with SPIN Selling, BANT , or other sales frameworks;
  • Tech-savvy, organized, multitasker, and highly reliable;
  • Comfortable working under goals and fast-paced environments.
