title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)


Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.


Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.


Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools .



Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services .
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS , leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch , etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools .
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch .
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.


Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs , and microservices .
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS .
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS ).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , AWS CloudFormation , or AWS CDK .
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Deep understanding of performance tuning, logging, and distributed tracing in cloud environments.


Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Knowledge of database performance tuning (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with API security , OAuth2/JWT , and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. Skills:

title: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
description:
Who are we:

Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.

We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.

With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.

Neotalent, the responsive people.

Find out more about us at


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Dynamics 365 CE Solution Architect / CRM Consultant to join one of our biggest clients, a global technology consultancy focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions across industries.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead a strategic technical assessment, contribute to the simplification and optimisation of a complex CRM ecosystem, and help define the roadmap for long-term transformation, we have the ideal project for your career.

Come energize your future with us!


Location: Full-remote from Brazil (English fluency required)


What you will do:

• Evaluate the current Dynamics 365 CE architecture, customizations, entity model, and configuration

• Identify sources of complexity, performance bottlenecks, and fragility

• Recommend strategies to simplify the architecture and reduce technical debt

• Analyse integrations including Dataverse OData APIs, Outbound Event Messages, and ESB

• Review data flows, reconciliation challenges, and environment promotion processes

• Propose robust data governance and integration patterns

• Assess Azure DevOps pipelines and multi-environment deployment practices

• Recommend automation improvements for deployment reliability

• Review managed service framework and suggest future support models

• Produce findings and recommendations report

• Define short-term stabilisation and medium-term optimisation roadmap

• Prepare proposal for next-phase implementation


What you are like:

• Senior-level expertise in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales Enterprise module)

• Strong experience with integration technologies: Dataverse APIs, ESB messaging, web services

• Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies

• Proven experience in CRM architecture rationalisation and modernisation

• Experience assessing managed service models and support optimisation

• Advanced problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

• Ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations

• Strong understanding of data modelling, reconciliation, and automation

• Comfortable working in fast-paced discovery phases (2–3 weeks)

• Proactive and independent, with strong alignment capabilities


Why join us:

• Work on challenging projects for big clients

• Learn more about emerging technologies

• Possibility of working remotely

• Design your career plan

• Access to continuous training and certifications

• Evolve through our internal mobility program

• … and much more!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer "#983334"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio da entrega de serviços exclusivos que combinam escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão de obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , o que nos permite estar próximos de nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e temos orgulho de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos o compromisso de atrair e reter os melhores talentos, construindo conexões reais para a vida. Atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas.

Acreditamos que, ao unir talento, tecnologia e organizações certas, é possível desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucesso — tanto para os clientes que atendemos quanto para os consultores que contratamos.

Cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia.

Compartilha desses valores? Então aqui é o seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo e aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e manter o portfólio de serviços e aplicações do time de Developer Tools.
  • Atuar diretamente com times técnicos e de negócio para garantir o bom funcionamento de soluções voltadas a Data Warehousing e Analytics , com foco em GitHub e ferramentas de automação.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes globais, incluindo Software Security Group , Infrastructure Operations , Cloud Services , Managed Service Providers e Developer Community .
  • Administrar e otimizar ambientes de GitHub e JFrog , aplicando boas práticas de CI/CD (GitHub Actions) e automação de deploys.
  • Executar atividades de security scanning , gerenciamento de módulos reutilizáveis (Reusable Modules, YAML ) e integração com ambientes em nuvem (Azure) .
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts automatizados (Bash, PowerShell ), além de APIs (REST APIs ).
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e segurança para melhorar continuamente os processos de suporte e interação técnica.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e antecipar mudanças no cenário tecnológico, garantindo melhoria contínua na operação e suporte aos usuários.


O que você precisa ter

  • 3+ anos de experiência em funções técnicas relacionadas a DevOps, Developer Tools, Cloud ou Data Engineering .
  • Experiência com GitHub , CI/CD (GitHub Actions) e JFrog .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de software e security scanning .
  • Experiência com Azure ou outras plataformas de nuvem.
  • Familiaridade com gerenciamento de código-fonte (Git) , testes automatizados e metodologias ágeis .
  • Conhecimento prático em YAML e módulos reutilizáveis .
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas técnicos complexos , com boa comunicação e foco em atendimento ao cliente.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente , para interação com equipes globais.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com DevSecOps e práticas ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software , especialmente em JavaScript, TypeScript ou Python .
  • Experiência com automação de scripts (Bash, PowerShell) .
  • Conhecimento em APIs (REST APIs) e integração de sistemas.
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes colaborativos e internacionais .
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com boa capacidade de priorização e entrega sob pressão.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office.


Modelo

CLT

title: Gerente de projetos sênior
description:
Somos a única solução completa para o mercado financeiro!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação no mercado, e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe e mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros.


Requisitos

Contexto da Função

Atuação em projetos back-office, com foco na Diretoria de Finanças, sendo a área Fiscal/Tributária e Contábil os principais demandantes.

Ambiente com baixa maturidade em gestão de projetos, exigindo acompanhamento próximo, escalonamento quando necessário e suporte à gestão direta para garantir entregas.


Responsabilidades Principais

Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos relacionados a processos financeiros, fiscais e contábeis.

Garantir documentação completa e organizada (cronogramas, atas, planos de risco).

Realizar gestão de riscos, mapeando e mitigando impedimentos.

Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para resolver bloqueios e garantir cumprimento de prazos.

Apoiar a gestão direta na visibilidade das atividades e status dos projetos.


Ferramentas e Tecnologias

SAP (módulos FI/CO e MM – estoque).

Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: MS Project, Jira, Trello).

Excel avançado para relatórios e controles.


Perfil Desejado

Senso de urgência e comprometimento com resultados.

Proatividade: “corre atrás” para remover impedimentos e garantir entregas.

Excelente comunicação e habilidade para lidar com áreas diversas.

Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e em ambientes com baixa maturidade.

Forte orientação para processos e documentação.


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia em projetos fiscais/tributários e contábeis.

Conhecimento em governança de projetos e metodologias (PMBOK, Agile híbrido).

Vivência em ambientes corporativos com sistemas ERP (SAP).


Presencial 3x na semana na Berrini, São Paulo - SP.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Azure Data Engineer, Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Azure Data Bricks; Azure Data Factory; Azure Data Services

Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Use of Data Quality tools (Great Expectations, Soda).

Knowledge of Step Functions, EventBridge, or Kinesis.

Best practices for API security (Cognito, WAF, IAM Policies).

Good communication and teamwork.

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Ability to handle agile environments and rapid changes.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, etc.)

Build high-performance data processing solutions with Apache Spark (PySpark) on Azure Databricks.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver clean, reliable datasets.

Optimize data workflows/pipelines for performance and cost efficiency in a cloud environment.

Implement best practices around data security, governance, and compliance.

Develop CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance existing data solutions for reliability and performance.

Document design patterns, best practices, and operational procedures.

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.

title: Fullstack - Vue / Nuxt - Developer
description:
POSITION: Fullstack Developer - Vue / Nuxt
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

AtlasIntel seeks talented Fullstack Engineers with a focus on frontend development . If you excel at building sleek, user-friendly interfaces and solving complex problems , you’ll thrive on our team. We value candidates with a strong algorithmic foundation , analytical prowess , and a proactive mindset .

Our ideal engineers are self-starters who can handle dynamic, fast-paced environments , manage multiple projects , and embrace learning new technologies. You’ll collaborate with designers , engineers , and stakeholders to drive the next generation of our platforms and tools.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will

  • Develop robust APIs for various applications.
  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions .
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews , testing , and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.


WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js .
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6) , HTML5 , CSS , and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt .
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills , attention to detail , and an ability to learn quickly.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python , Java , or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture


ABOUT US

AtlasIntel is a fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Our cutting-edge polling and market research tools have established us as the most accurate pollster for both the 2024 and 2020 US presidential elections. Founded by two Harvard PhDs, we specialize in real-time data collection and analytics that fuel dashboards with insights spanning economics, politics, culture, and society. Join us and help shape the future of data-driven intelligence.


WHY ATLASINTEL?
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that’s revolutionizing the polling industry.
  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
  • Work in a dynamic environment where innovation and learning are encouraged.
  • Contribute to products that have real-world impact on business, politics, and society.

﻿

APPLY TODAY!

Join us on our journey to shape the future of polling and market research. Reach out to us at or visit our website at for more information.

title: Sales Account Executive (Fluent English)
description:
Sales Account Executive – U.S. Market (Remote)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, consistency, and growth. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we provide a structured and high-performance environment for sales professionals who aim to grow internationally. This position is for sales professionals ready to lead B2B prospecting in the U.S. market , with real opportunities for development, recognition, and long-term stability.


What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 reais + USD-based bonuses ;
  • 100% remote work, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);
  • Exposure to U.S. executive-level sales culture;
  • Intensive onboarding (3–5 weeks) and internal certifications.


What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify B2B leads through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach;
  • Track key sales metrics and pipeline performance;
  • Conduct meetings and present solutions to U.S.-based executives;
  • Collaborate with Business Development and CRM teams for process improvement;
  • Maintain a disciplined, results-driven sales rhythm.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in Business Sales / Outbound reach ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – clear, natural communication in meetings;
  • Familiar with SPIN Selling, BANT , or other sales frameworks;
  • Tech-savvy, organized, multitasker, and highly reliable;
  • Comfortable working under goals and fast-paced environments.

title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)


Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.


Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.


Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools .



Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services .
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS , leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch , etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools .
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch .
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.


Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs , and microservices .
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS .
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS ).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , AWS CloudFormation , or AWS CDK .
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Deep understanding of performance tuning, logging, and distributed tracing in cloud environments.


Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Knowledge of database performance tuning (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with API security , OAuth2/JWT , and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity

CAI Software is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, , genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

Disability Accommodation

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact us at or send an e-mail with your specific accommodation request.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. CAI Software does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of citizenship or immigration status in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA) .

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c).

description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Content Risk Manager [Policy]
description:
The ideal candidate will serve as the primary escalation point for commercial policy issues, develop and maintain commercial safety SOPs, and collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Risk Engineering, Moderation, Legal, and GR/PR teams to drive aligned and effective solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze advertising content, advertiser behavior, and moderation data to identify policy gaps, emerging risks, and optimization opportunities, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Lead risk control for advertising materials and monetized content, including quality monitoring, ad violation detection, trend analysis, and enforcement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to design and enhance advertising risk control systems that improve governance efficiency.
  • Identify and resolve systematic issues across moderation operations, sales, and partner teams, ensuring alignment on risk-benefit tradeoffs.
  • Ensure all advertising policies comply with local laws, such as consumer protection and data privacy, as well as cultural norms in each market.
  • Lead and execute emergency response plans for high-risk advertising incidents or regulatory changes affecting the region.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Business, Marketing, Business Law, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in English (both written and spoken).
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital advertising, commercial policy, ad risk control, monetization integrity, or compliance.
  • Strong expertise in e-commerce or financial advertising, counterfeit goods, fraud detection, and deceptive advertiser behavior.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience, particularly with sales and monetization teams.
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising ecosystems and monetization models.


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a global tech or social media company.
  • Familiarity with local regulatory frameworks in LatAm markets.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;

  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript: para desenvolvimento de plugins e customizações.
  • Go, Quarkus: para desenvolvimento
  • Docker: para empacotamento e deploy de projetos CMS.
  • MySQL, Postgree e MongoDB: para integração com bancos de dados.
  • REST APIs: para consumo e exposição de dados via CMS.
  • Git e Jenkins/GitHub Actions: para versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Arquitetura e infraestrutura de software.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Full Stack Developer" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, consistency, and growth. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we provide a structured and high-performance environment for sales professionals who aim to grow internationally. This position is for sales professionals ready to lead B2B prospecting in the U.S. market , with real opportunities for development, recognition, and long-term stability.


What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 reais + USD-based bonuses ;
  • 100% remote work, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);

  • Intensive onboarding (3–5 weeks) and internal certifications.


What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify B2B leads through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach;
  • Track key sales metrics and pipeline performance;
  • Conduct meetings and present solutions to U.S.-based executives;
  • Collaborate with Business Development and CRM teams for process improvement;
  • Maintain a disciplined, results-driven sales rhythm.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in Business Sales / Outbound reach ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – clear, natural communication in meetings;
  • Familiar with SPIN Selling, BANT , or other sales frameworks;
  • Tech-savvy, organized, multitasker, and highly reliable;
  • Comfortable working under goals and fast-paced environments.

title: .NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)
description:
.NET Architect (AWS & Cloud Modernization)


Remote (Brazil-based)

Candidates must be resident in Brazil and eligible to work remotely from within the country.


Salary:

$7,000-9,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.


Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced .NET Architect with deep expertise in AWS Cloud Services and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will lead the modernization of existing applications, architect scalable and cost-efficient solutions, and drive performance optimization through effective use of .NET Core and AWS tools .



Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design

  • Define, design, and implement cloud-native and hybrid architectures leveraging .NET Core and AWS services .
  • Lead modernization initiatives, re-platforming legacy .NET applications into scalable, containerized, or serverless solutions.
  • Establish and enforce coding, security, and performance standards aligned with best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize workloads on AWS , leveraging services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch , etc.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deliver robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools .
  • Drive cost optimization strategies to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability.

Performance & Monitoring

  • Implement comprehensive observability and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch .
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, ensuring low-latency, high-availability systems.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, consistent, and maintainable architecture.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in architectural decision-making and technology direction.


Key Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with advanced knowledge of .NET Framework and .NET Core, Web APIs , and microservices .
  • Proven experience architecting and deploying workloads on AWS .
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS ).

Cloud & DevOps

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , AWS CloudFormation , or AWS CDK .
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Deep understanding of performance tuning, logging, and distributed tracing in cloud environments.


Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Knowledge of database performance tuning (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Experience with API security , OAuth2/JWT , and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).
